d8a5f6dbe4f3365c6ee5c5d8c9b4b001f7c26e0e.summary: Bitdefender Labs report, published 2018-02-01, on Operation PZChao, a custom-built malware campaign the team had monitored for several months, mainly in Asia. The report links the activity to the Iron Tiger APT and says Gh0st RAT variants were among the most-downloaded files. Its command-and-control setup uses a network of malicious subdomains for download, upload, remote-access actions and malware DLL delivery. The report states that the new samples connect to new attack infrastructure and frames the activity as a possible return of Iron Tiger.

actors.q: Operation PZChao: a possible return of the Iron Tiger APT

tools.q: variants of Gh0st RAT used in Iron Tiger APT operation

techniques.q: features a network of malicious subdomains, each one used for a specific task
we managed to retrieve the malware payloads hosted on one of the command and control

hedges: The title frames the activity as 'a possible return' of the Iron Tiger APT, not a confirmed one.
Background on Iron Tiger is pointed to a TrendMicro research paper rather than given in this report.
